about.title: Our Journey Since 2014
about.p1: Founded in 2014 in Luanda, PEPEK GRUPO RENT-A-CAR was built on an uncompromising commitment to elevate executive mobility in Angola.
about.p2: Today, we operate from strategic hubs in Luanda, Huambo, and Bengo, serving over 5,000 clients and managing high-level motorcades for governments, embassies, and summits.
about.val1Desc: Real-time fleet tracking and chauffeurs trained in safety protocols and defensive driving.
about.val2Desc: Advance arrival for all transfer services and rigorous route management.
about.val3Desc: Maximum confidentiality and impeccable etiquette for diplomatic missions and corporate executives.
about.val4Desc: 24/7 dedicated account manager to instantly adapt to itinerary changes.
about.heroTitle: Driven by people. Guided by excellence.
about.heroDesc: We are an Angolan mobility company turning every journey into a safe, comfortable and carefully managed experience.
about.check2: Solutions for individuals, companies and institutions
about.missionDesc: To provide high-quality, efficient and personalised mobility solutions, ensuring comfort, confidence and service excellence.
about.visionDesc: To become a benchmark in Angola's vehicle rental sector, recognised for innovation, quality, responsible growth and sustainability.
about.promiseDesc: To exceed expectations through well-maintained vehicles, prepared teams and a response tailored to every client's needs.
about.principle1Desc: We listen carefully and build mobility solutions that are genuinely tailored to each need.
about.principle2Desc: We act with clarity, fairness and accountability in every relationship and operation.
about.principle3Desc: We keep our vehicles to rigorous standards of safety, cleanliness and operational readiness.
about.principle4Desc: We continually improve fleet management and seek to reduce the impact of our operations.
about.supportTitle: A team prepared before, during and after
about.supportIntro: Excellence does not end when the vehicle leaves. Our team follows the operation and remains available when plans change.
about.support1Desc: Experienced professionals available by reservation in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
about.support2Desc: Assistance by phone, email and WhatsApp throughout every stage of the service.
about.support3Desc: Support for emergencies, questions and booking changes at any time.
about.teamIntro: A young, approachable team committed to understanding every client and continually raising service standards.
